scope: Independent static control review and actual existing data/readback identity checks only. No VM, application, DLL, compiler, or transport-fixture execution.

executionContract.run: RUN.PS1:8-29 refuses existing three roots, verifies pinned carrier/ZIP and exact 4815-member regular-file extraction before moving fresh roots; :31-45 uses a fresh evidence folder, invokes the shipped controller, and preserves its original exit.
executionContract.cohort: Default omitted selection is x86:desktop,x86:modern,x64:desktop,x64:modern. Current root has no project.json; desktop resolves SouiStarter/default plus SouiWorkbench/default and react, modern resolves SouiModernStarter/default. This is eight application runs from six current executable identities, not eight distinct EXE files.
executionContract.publicEntries: Guest-Owned-Smokes.cjs:43-85 validates both current MSVC143 build reports and prepared Runner, then invokes public Test.ps1 -NativeOnly / Test-Modern.ps1 serially. NativeOnly bypasses unit/build stages; no guest compiler or package installer is requested.
executionContract.acceptance: Both inner application and outer stage readers require current exact argv/cwd/EXE/Runner/context/PID/birth identity and natural root0/supervisor0, completed closure, zero active-before-cleanup, no STOP/fallback/timeout/terminated Job. A compiler-tail policy cannot qualify these runtime stages.
executionContract.failureRetention: Controller:88-115 retains failure, collects complete new smoke-owned/modern-owned attempts and attempted smoke receipts, writes failed Summary and raw export catalog, then exits1. Public inner reader preserves previous app logs before replacing only its owned diagnostic; current raw stdout/stderr/ndjson/context/finished/app bytes remain. Fresh roots/evidence and wx/CreateNew prevent overwriting prior failed attempts.

serialContract.export: EXPORT.PS1:9-38 verifies original complete-file lengths and SHA256, rejects excess rather than truncating, carries base64 original bytes inside gzip; :42-51 writes COM1 with a 900000ms loop guard and individual 15000ms WriteTimeout. This is a separate transport budget, not an extension of any application budget, and is not represented as a strict <=900000ms total wall deadline.
serialContract.extract: Extract-Serial.cjs:5-42 requires a new host output, unique selected complete BEGIN/META/ordered DATA/END frame, strict base64, compressed/envelope/catalog/per-file hashes and exact sizes, bounded decompression, exact payload keys, guest path bounds and exclusive writes. Partial serial prefix cannot qualify as a complete export.
serialContract.noTestPass: Exporter meta and extractor result use testPassed:null. Transport completion proves raw transfer only.

operationalBoundaries: RUN returns the controller original exit even when EXPORT fails; read CONTROLLER_EXIT and EXPORT_EXIT separately and require a complete hash-verified host extraction before accepting exported evidence. RUN0 alone proves neither export nor GUI success.
If preparation/controller aborts before an export catalog, RUN says to preserve original guest files and exits1; this review does not substitute for missing raw evidence.
A partial stage selection is explicitly partial. Only all four actual successful stages qualify the full eight-run cohort.
Existing result steps are data preparation only. This review makes no GUI observation, runtime pass, DevTools-open, network, performance, long-test, or production qualification claim.
